name: Jian Ai
source:
Do you know what love is? This game is trying to give our answer. This game encourages people to have a sensitive and gentle heart. Enjoy!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/939400/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你知道什么是爱吗？这款游戏试图给出我们的答案，鼓励人们拥有敏感而温柔的心。祝你享受游戏！

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/939400/]Steam[/url]]
